errors.description: Bounding the cardinality of a terminal member: D\{p} has |D|-1 primes, so the correct inequality is 2^{|D|-1} <= w(D\{p}) < a_1, not 2^{|D|}. The stated conclusion |D| <= a_1 still follows, so this is a harmless typo.

parsed.notes: Correct and complete: greedy-scan reformulation, support-only acceptance, self-dual family F, intersecting antichain C of minimal supports, sunflower-based finiteness for bounded size, weight-descent to bounded-size members containing any given prime, hence C finite and acceptance periodic mod L. Final T/L argument is sound.
